intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Your game's next update has a list of props that all need starting geometry built by hand before artists can refine them.

Tripo Studio Team Plan gives your art team a shared workspace to generate those starting models from text or reference images, then refine them in their existing tools — reducing the initial geometry work; your team still handles cleanup and approval.
• **Tripo generates the starting geometry:** Artists get a usable base mesh for props on the project list.
• **Your team handles refinement and approval:** Artists adjust the shape and materials, review the result in the engine, and approve what meets the game's requirements.

**To help you evaluate the real cost savings,** we'd be happy to help plan a pilot with 10 real project assets. Compare time through final approval, including generation, cleanup and testing.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.

• **Tripo生成初版几何体：** 为项目清单上的道具提供可用的基础网格。

**为了帮您评估实际节省成本，** 我们愿意一起规划用10个真实项目资产做试点。比较到最终验收的时间，包括生成、清理和测试。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的10个资产试点。

followup.en:

• Include artist cleanup, materials, review, tool compatibility and engine checks through final approval.

That comparison shows which assets need less total work and which are better made with the current process. Your team keeps the art direction and final approval.

Before starting, Tripo and your team need to agree the asset list, available evaluation support, who runs the checks and which records can be supplied. Scope, availability, access and fees also need confirmation.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.

followup.en:

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Your team reviews and approves props for one game build. When the next build needs similar assets, artists rebuild them or request the same file through another handoff.

Tripo Studio Team Plan pools team-generated models in a shared library with visible credit usage and member activity. Artists find previously reviewed work; you avoid rebuilding or re-requesting files — saving handoff time without removing your existing approval process.
• **Tripo keeps team resources in one workspace:** Artists search shared models under the workspace visibility settings; admins monitor the credit pool and member usage.
• **Your team controls what gets reused:** Artists use their existing review process to identify approved work, then check changes against the next build's requirements.

**To help you evaluate collaboration savings,** we'd be happy to help plan a pilot with 10 real assets. Compare reuse frequency, handoff count, admin time and final quality.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.

立即联系我们，安排您团队的10个资产试点。

followup.en:

Compare time, total cost and final quality. Reuse does not automatically mean less work.

Team Plan provides a shared library, pooled credits and member-usage visibility. Before starting, agree with Tripo on the assets, available support and records, responsibilities, access, availability and fees.

Tripo Studio Team Plan gives each team member their own workspace access while keeping shared models and credits in one place. Admins manage member roles and monitor usage without shared logins.

游戏下一版更新的道具都需要美术先手工搭建基础网格，才能开始精修。这项初始建模工作，每个资产都要重复一遍。

您的工程团队可以将Tripo API接入现有资产工具。美术通过您的工具，从文字或图像生成初版模型，再按常规流程精修——减少基础网格工作；清理和验收仍由您的团队负责。
• **Tripo API提供生成服务：** 您的工具请求模型;API返回美术可以继续开发的几何体。
• **您的团队负责精修和验收：** 美术在现有工具中调整模型，按游戏标准审核，批准符合要求的资产。

**为了帮您评估实施成本，** 我们愿意一起规划用10个真实项目资产做试点，比较到最终验收的时间，包括API集成、生成和测试。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的10个资产试点。

followup.en:
A useful comparison ends with an approved game prop, not the first model file.

For a 10-asset API test, your team uses real prop briefs and its current acceptance criteria. For each asset, record the time to its first useful starting model and its first approved output. Include generation and retry fees, unsuccessful attempts, artist cleanup, materials, review and engine checks. Integration and ongoing maintenance count too.

The API supports generation requests, task status and model retrieval. Your engineers connect those steps to the asset tool; artists do the remaining production work. Topology, polygon count, UVs, formats and any necessary rigging are checked against the game's requirements.

The result should make it clear which props take less work, which need substantial repair and which are better handled by the current process.

Before testing, your team and Tripo agree the asset list, evaluation support, who performs the checks and who records the results, along with scope, availability, access and fees.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.

subject.zh: 先用真实道具测返工成本,再扩大AI使用

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Before expanding AI in your game workflow, you need to see the rework cost on real props: how much cleanup, testing and iteration it takes to get generated models through your approval process.

Your engineering team puts Tripo's API into your asset tools. Artists generate models from requirements, refine them and test against game standards — letting you measure the complete cost on your own assets, not preview images.
• **Tripo API provides generation:** Your tools request models; the API returns geometry your team refines.
• **Your team measures quality and rework:** Artists test generated models against your checklist: topology, engine compatibility, iteration count to approval.

**To help you evaluate expansion fit,** we propose that Tripo run an agreed evaluation of 10 real assets against your team's standards and share the results. Supported checks, scope and fees need confirmation first.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

在游戏工作流中扩大AI使用之前，您需要看清真实道具的返工成本：生成模型通过审批流程，需要多少清理、测试和迭代工作。

您的工程团队将Tripo API接入资产工具。美术根据需求生成模型、精修、按游戏标准测试——让您能用自己的资产测量完整成本，而不是预览图。
• **Tripo API提供生成：** 您的工具请求模型;API返回团队精修的几何体。
• **您的团队测量质量和返工：** 美术按清单测试生成模型：拓扑、引擎兼容性、到批准的迭代次数。

**为了帮您评估扩展适配，** 我们建议由Tripo按您团队的标准及双方约定的范围，对10个真实资产执行评测并分享结果。开始前需确认支持哪些检查、范围和费用。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的10个资产试点。

followup.en:
The acceptance checklist is the benchmark. Your team defines what each of the 10 game assets must meet before testing starts.

Depending on the asset, checks can cover shape, art direction, topology, polygon count, UVs, materials, format and rigging. Artists refine the model and review the result in the target engine. A successful API task confirms generation, not approval.

Track which checks pass, what needs fixing and which assets are rejected. For each asset, compare time to its first approved output and total cost, including generation, retries, failed attempts, refinement, review, engine testing, integration and maintenance. This makes the trade-off visible when a convincing first result takes substantial work to finish.

We propose that Tripo run the agreed evaluation against your team’s checklist and share the results. Supported checks, scope, availability, access, fees and records need confirmation first. Your team handles integration and artist cleanup, and keeps final approval.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.

记录哪些检查通过、哪里需要修、哪些资产未被采用。逐个资产比较得到首个通过验收的结果所需的时间和总成本，计入生成、重试、失败尝试、精修、审核、引擎测试、接入和维护。初版看着不错但后面还需大量加工，这部分代价也要看清。

我们建议由 Tripo 按您的验收清单执行双方约定的评测，并分享结果。开始前，先确认可支持的检查项、范围、是否可安排、使用权限、费用和记录。接入与美术清理由您的团队负责，最终批准权不变。

intro.en:

Your tools can store request details, changes and approval status alongside the file. Tripo's API provides generation task IDs your tools can link to internal records — letting reviewers find the approved version without retracing requests.
• **Tripo API provides task identifiers:** Each generation returns an ID your tools can store with the asset file.
• **Your team builds the record system:** Your tools store inputs, changes, approval notes and link them to Tripo task IDs for reference.

**To help you evaluate tracing time savings,** we'd be happy to help plan a pilot with 10 real assets. Compare time spent finding approved versions and the records reviewers need.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.

您的工具可以将请求详情、改动和批准状态存在文件旁。Tripo API提供生成任务ID，您的工具可以关联到内部记录——让审核者能找到批准版本，无需重新追溯请求。

• **您的团队构建记录系统：** 您的工具存储输入、改动、批准备注，并关联Tripo任务ID供参考。

followup.en:

For each asset, record the time to its first approved output alongside missing links, rejected assets, failures and retries. Count integration and record maintenance, generation charges, retry fees, artist refinement, review and engine checks. Record quality and the work to keep it matter alongside the quality of the assets.

Before testing, agree with Tripo on the data and support available, responsibilities, scope, availability, access and fees. Your team sets retention and disclosure requirements and checks input rights. No compliance certification or rights clearance is included by implication.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Before committing the next level's props to an AI workflow, you need to see the complete production cost: generation time, rework to fit the level's style, engine testing and assets that don't pass.

With Tripo Studio Team Plan, your artists generate starting models from text or reference images and refine them in their existing tools. That workflow lets you test the full cost on real level assets, not just attractive preview images.
• **Tripo provides the starting geometry:** Your artists get a model to develop against the level's technical and visual requirements.
• **Your team reviews against level standards:** Artists check the result fits the scene, works in the target engine, and approve what meets acceptance criteria.

Tripo's chest walkthrough shows the work from generation through game interaction.

**To help you evaluate project fit,** we propose that Tripo run an agreed evaluation of 10 real level assets against your team's criteria and share the results. Supported checks, scope and fees need confirmation first.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

在将下一关的道具交给AI工作流之前，您需要看清完整生产成本：生成时间、为适应关卡风格的返工、引擎测试，以及未通过的资产。

使用Tripo Studio Team Plan，美术从文字或参考图生成初版，再在现有工具里精修。这套流程让您能用真实关卡资产测试完整成本，而不只看吸引人的预览图。
• **Tripo提供初版几何体：** 美术获得可按关卡技术和视觉要求继续开发的模型。
• **您的团队按关卡标准审核：** 检查结果是否适配场景、在目标引擎中是否正常，批准符合验收标准的资产。

Tripo的宝箱示例展示了从生成到游戏交互的制作过程。

**为了帮您评估项目适配，** 我们建议由Tripo按您团队的标准及双方约定的范围，对10个真实关卡资产执行评测并分享结果。开始前需确认支持哪些检查、范围和费用。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的10个资产试点。

followup.en:
The chest walkthrough shows one prop moving from generation through artist work to an opening interaction. It is a Studio example, not a guarantee for other assets.

For 10 real assets from your game, we propose that Tripo run an evaluation against your team's checklist and share the results. First, both sides need to confirm supported checks, scope, fees and the records to deliver.
• Assess topology, polygon count, UVs, materials and file formats against the scene's requirements.
• Include target-engine, rigging or interaction checks where the prop needs them and Tripo can support them.

Your artists still refine the props; your team gives final approval and handles checks outside the agreed scope. Compare quality, time and cost through approval, including generation and retry fees, unsuccessful attempts, revisions, review, tool compatibility and engine testing.

Availability and access also need confirmation before starting.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
followup.zh:
宝箱示例展示了一个道具从生成、经过美术制作，到实现开箱交互的过程。这是 Studio 示例，不是对其他资产的效果保证。

针对您游戏中的 10 个真实资产，我们建议由 Tripo 按您团队的验收清单执行评测并分享结果。双方需先确认支持哪些检查、评测范围、费用，以及交付哪些记录。
• 按场景要求检查拓扑、面数、UV、材质和文件格式。
• 道具需要目标引擎、绑定或交互检查时，按 Tripo 确认可支持的范围纳入评测。

道具精修仍由您的美术负责，最终验收及约定范围之外的检查仍由您的团队负责。比较从生成到验收的质量、工时和成本时，生成与重试费用、失败尝试、修改、审核、工具适配和引擎测试都应计入。

开始前，还需确认是否可安排及使用权限。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的 10 个资产试点。

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Your team approves a crate for one scene. When another scene needs a similar prop, artists rebuild it or request the approved file through another handoff.

Tripo Studio Team Plan pools team-generated models in a shared library with visible credit and member usage. Artists find previously approved work; you avoid rebuilding or re-requesting — saving handoff work without removing scene-specific checks.
• **Tripo keeps team resources in one workspace:** Artists search shared models; admins monitor credit pool and member usage through the workspace panel.
• **Your team checks each scene's requirements:** Artists use their existing review to identify approved base work, then verify the asset fits the new scene's needs.

**To help you evaluate reuse savings,** we'd be happy to help plan a pilot with 10 real assets. Compare reuse frequency, cross-scene adaptation work and handoff count.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.

Tripo Studio Team Plan将团队生成的模型汇集到共享库，可查看积分和成员用量。美术能找到之前批准的成果;避免重做或重复请求——节省交接工作，同时保留场景专属检查。
• **Tripo在同一工作区集中管理团队资源：** 美术搜索共享模型;管理员通过工作区面板监控积分池和成员用量。
• **您的团队检查每个场景的要求：** 美术用现有审核识别已批准的基础成果，再验证资产是否符合新场景需求。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的10个资产试点。

followup.en:

• Compare changes, review and engine checks, plus original generation and retry fees, unsuccessful attempts and cleanup.

That shows the total time, cost and final quality, not just how many files were reused.

Team Plan supplies the shared library, credit pool and member-usage visibility. Your existing workflow identifies approved work and handles externally refined files. Reuse still needs review for the new scene. Before starting, agree with Tripo on the assets, available support, records, responsibilities, availability, access and fees.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

When your game team shares credentials, each member change means password resets, access list updates and tracking shared-account use. That admin work repeats with every hire or departure.

Tripo Studio Team Plan gives each member their own access while pooling shared models and credits in one workspace. Admins manage roles and monitor usage without shared logins.
• **Tripo separates individual access from team resources:** Each artist logs in independently; admins add, remove or adjust member roles through the workspace panel.
• **Your team keeps permission control:** Admins set visibility for shared work and monitor credit usage by member.

**To help you evaluate admin time savings,** we'd be happy to help plan a pilot with 10 real assets. Compare access management work when members change and time spent tracking usage.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
intro.zh:

Tripo Studio Team Plan让每位成员独立访问，同时在一个工作区内汇集共享模型和积分。管理员无需共享登录，即可管理角色和监控用量。

• **您的团队保留权限控制：** 管理员设置共享工作的可见性，按成员监控积分使用。

**为了帮您评估管理时间节省，** 我们愿意一起规划用10个真实资产做试点，比较成员变动时的访问管理工作及追踪用量的时间。

followup.en:

Your production process still determines input rights, reviewers, final approval and any disclosure. Before starting, Tripo and your team need to agree which records and evaluation support are available, who retains records and who performs each check.

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Before committing a full delivery batch to AI, you need to see rework on real assets: cleanup, client adjustments and iterations to delivery approval.

Your engineering team puts Tripo's API into your tools. Artists generate models, refine for delivery and test against client standards — measuring complete cost on real assets, not preview images.
• **Tripo API provides generation:** Your tools request models; the API returns geometry your team refines for delivery.
• **Your team measures batch quality:** Artists test against delivery checklist: format, client specs, iterations to approval.

**To help you evaluate batch fit,** we propose that Tripo run an agreed evaluation of 10 real assets against your standards and share results. Supported checks, scope and fees need confirmation first.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

在将整批交付交给AI之前，您需要看清真实资产的返工：清理、客户调整、到交付批准的迭代次数。

您的工程团队将Tripo API接入工具。美术生成模型、为交付精修、按客户标准测试——用真实资产测量完整成本，而不是预览图。
• **Tripo API提供生成：** 您的工具请求模型;API返回团队为交付精修的几何体。
• **您的团队测量批次质量：** 美术按交付清单测试：格式、客户规格、到批准的迭代次数。

**为了帮您评估批次适配，** 我们建议由Tripo按您的标准及双方约定的范围，对10个真实资产执行评测并分享结果。开始前需确认支持哪些检查、范围和费用。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的10个资产试点。

followup.en:
The recipient needs files that meet the brief, whether an asset began with generation or manual modelling.

For a 10-asset test, your team can use the same delivery checklist for both routes. It can cover geometry, topology, polygon count, UVs, materials, scale and the required file formats. Artists refine the models, open them in the intended software, review the results and approve the final files.

For each asset, compare delivered quality, time to its first approved output and total cost: generation, retries, failed attempts, cleanup, materials, file checks, review, integration and maintenance. Assets that fail a check remain visible in the results rather than disappearing from the totals.

We propose that Tripo evaluate the assets against your team’s agreed delivery checklist and share the results. Confirm supported checks, scope, availability, access, fees and records before testing. Your team owns integration, artist cleanup and final acceptance.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.
followup.zh:
接收方需要的是符合制作要求的文件，不论资产最初来自生成还是手工建模。

测试 10 个资产时，两条路线可以沿用团队同一份交付清单，包括几何、拓扑、面数、UV、材质、尺寸和需要的文件格式。美术精修模型，在目标软件中打开文件、审核结果，再批准最终文件。

逐个资产比较交付质量、得到首个通过验收的结果所需的时间和总成本：生成、重试、失败尝试、清理、材质、文件检查、审核、接入和维护。没有通过检查的资产仍保留在结果中，不从汇总里删除。

我们建议由 Tripo 按您的交付清单，执行双方约定的资产评测并分享结果。测试前，确认可支持的检查项、范围、是否可安排、使用权限、费用和记录。接入、美术清理和最终验收仍由您的团队负责。

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

When delivering assets, your team retraces generation requests, changes and which version the client approved. That handover search repeats for every delivery.

Your tools can store request details, changes and approval with the file. Tripo's API provides task IDs your tools link to delivery records — letting your team find approved files without retracing changes.
• **Tripo API provides task identifiers:** Each generation returns an ID your tools store with delivery files.
• **Your team builds the delivery system:** Your tools store inputs, changes, client approval and link them to Tripo task IDs.

**To help you evaluate handover time savings,** we'd be happy to help plan a pilot with 10 real assets. Compare time finding approved deliverables and records clients need.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

交付资产时，团队要重新追溯生成请求、改动、客户批准的是哪个版本。每次交付，这项交接搜索都要重复。

您的工具可以将请求详情、改动和批准存在文件旁。Tripo API提供任务ID，您的工具可以关联到交付记录——让团队能找到已批准文件，无需重新追溯改动。
• **Tripo API提供任务标识符：** 每次生成返回一个ID，您的工具与交付文件一起存储。
• **您的团队构建交付系统：** 您的工具存储输入、改动、客户批准，并关联Tripo任务ID。

**为了帮您评估交接时间节省，** 我们愿意一起规划用10个真实资产做试点，比较查找已批准交付成果的时间及客户需要的记录。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的10个资产试点。

followup.en:
Once an artist has refined a model, the final file needs to stay connected to the request and the review that approved it.

A 10-asset test can follow those connections inside your own tool. Your developers save the original request and inputs, collect the API task ID and results, then link working versions, review notes and approvals. Tripo supplies generation task information; your system builds and keeps the wider record.

For each asset, record time to its first approved output. Compare history-retrieval time, asset quality and total cost: integration, record maintenance, generation, retries, unsuccessful attempts, refinement, review and file checks in the intended production tool or viewer. Your team sets input permissions, retention, disclosure and final-use requirements.

Before testing, both teams would confirm available information, who checks each record, evaluation support, scope, access and fees. Your team approves the asset; API task data is neither a complete audit trail nor proof of rights or compliance.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.
followup.zh:

10 个资产的测试可以在自己的工具里核对这些关联。开发团队保存原始请求和输入，收集 API 任务 ID 与结果，再关联工作版本、审核意见和批准记录。Tripo 提供生成任务信息，更完整的记录由自己的系统建立并保存。

逐个资产记录得到首个通过验收的结果所需的时间。比较查找版本历史的时间、资产质量和总成本：接入、记录维护、生成、重试、失败尝试、精修、审核，以及在目标制作工具或查看器中的文件检查。输入素材权限、保存期限、披露和最终用途要求由您的团队确定。

测试前，双方需确认可取得的信息、谁检查各项记录、评测支持、范围、使用权限和费用。资产由您的团队批准；API 任务信息既不是完整审计记录，也不证明权利或合规。
